slides.title: Cold air, [[warm]] rooms
slides.body: Chilly wind outside and heated, dry air inside can leave lips, hands and hair feeling rough. Washing more often adds to it.

slides.title: Shorter [[days]]
slides.body: Less daylight and colder mornings make it easy to skip water, walks and stretching, while evenings stretch out on screens.

items.head: A. Lips and hands first
items.sub: Balm and hand cream after washing

items.head: B. Warm sips all day
items.sub: Keep a mug of warm water nearby

items.head: C. Screens down early
items.sub: Dim lights and wind down by bedtime
